item.title: Does the United States Need to Fear Iran’s Air Defense Systems?
item.description: Iran is unable to defend its airspace by conventional means. Instead, it has attempted to preserve deterrence by stockpiling missiles for use against nearby US bases. The post Does the United States Need to Fear Iran’s Air Defense Systems? appeared first on The National Interest.
